subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt the open shared-bootstrap TLS fingerprint PR as the canonical fix, or ask for a fresh narrow replacement?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but an open proof-positive PR already owns the right shared path and is conflicting, so opening another ClawSweeper fix PR would duplicate active work.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the shared-bootstrap PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the canonical fix path, resolve conflicts, and rerun the gateway/bootstrap approval validation before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement PR
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting branch only if a new PR preserves the same shared resolver scope and proof coverage.

options.title: Defer the issue
options.body: Keep this issue open without another fix PR if maintainers want to wait for the contributor, accepting that local TLS approval clients remain broken.

recommendation.title: Adopt and rebase the shared-bootstrap PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the canonical fix path, resolve conflicts, and rerun the gateway/bootstrap approval validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main line provenance points at recent maintainer-owned gateway-adjacent refactor history, making this the best available routing handle for the decision.
